signals in the source: the document's title band; the opening of a new part with its own title band
never when: never mid-page; never on page 2 unless a new part of the document starts there
fields: heading(the title, <=95 chars, the topic and the angle, never 'Two-pager')

story shape: a page or product title without a picture
signals in the source: a product or programme name with its promise; a new theme opening a page
never when: never for a figure ('2.3M Schools') or a partner name; never a title the document does not have
fields: heading(<=55 chars), highlight(2-3 words copied exactly from heading, set in the accent, may be empty)

signals in the source: paragraphs or a short list under a heading
never when: never three in a row; never for figures, settings or side-by-side columns; split one over ~900 chars
fields: rail(the section label, <=28 chars, sentence case, e.g. "The challenge", "What we do"), items(1-8: kind "para"|"bullet"|"number" (a numbered list when the order matters), label(bold lead-in such as a country or programme name followed by a full stop, <=24 chars, usually empty), body(a paragraph, <=480 chars; a bullet <=160 chars))

signals in the source: a number written large with what it counts under it, in a row
never when: never without real figures; never a page number; never a caption from another line
fields: items(3, 4 or 6: label(the figure with its unit, <=7 chars: "2.2B", "44k+", "30-50%", "€120k"), body(what it counts, <=55 chars)), accent(index of one card to set in orange, the most striking, or -1)

story shape: a map or a photo of the place
signals in the source: the piece is about one country, or the document shows a full-width picture
fields: map(a country name when the piece is about one country, else ""), body(caption, <=110 chars, may be empty)

signals in the source: three parallel items with a bold title and a short text, often with icons
never when: never for more or fewer than 3
fields: rail(the side title when the document gives one, else ""), items(3: label(<=22 chars), body(<=210 chars), icon(a Lucide icon name, e.g. "map-pin", "handshake", "hand-coins", "school", "wifi", "heart-pulse", "shield-check", "chart-column"))

signals in the source: labelled paragraphs, each an opportunity and how the partner could help
never when: never for a short list (use numbered)
fields: heading(<=80 chars, e.g. "Shaping the next phase together"), items(2-4: label(<=40 chars), body(<=520 chars))

signals in the source: two headed columns side by side (now vs asked, partners vs prospects, before vs after)
capacity: 2 long columns, runs on to the next page; ~15pt a line
never when: never split into two tables; never flattened into sections
fields: items(exactly 2: label(column head, <=40 chars), body(lines: "# Subhead" for a bold subhead, "- " for a bullet, "**Name**: text" for a bold name leading a line or bullet, otherwise a paragraph; <=1800 chars)), accent(1 when the second column is the ask, drawn in orange, else -1)

signals in the source: 2-6 short items, each a name and one line, about where the work happens or who it reaches
capacity: 2-6 cards, 2 to a row; ~150pt a row
never when: never for abstract ideas with no fitting library photo
fields: rail(<=28 chars), items(2 to 6: label(<=28 chars), body(<=60 chars))

story shape: the start of a new part inside a page
signals in the source: a subtitle that opens the ask or a new theme mid-page
never when: never at the top of page 1; never invented

story shape: what the piece is, in one paragraph
signals in the source: the opening paragraph under the title, with no label of its own
never when: never after a banner when the paragraph has a label

story shape: where a product or project stands
signals in the source: a status line: concept, prototype, pilot, live
fields: lead(the label with its colon, e.g. "Status:"), body(<=320 chars)

story shape: one phase, region or site with its picture
signals in the source: a short tagged paragraph beside a map or a picture
never when: never more than one per page
fields: tag(the pill, <=16 chars, e.g. "Phase 1"), body(<=300 chars), map(a country name when the panel is about one country, else ""), photo

story shape: what a digital tool looks like
signals in the source: the brief asks for screenshots, or the piece is about an app or platform
fields: rail(<=28 chars, may be empty), items(exactly 2: label(""), body(""))

story shape: what the reader is asked to do
signals in the source: asks or next steps, one sentence each, where the order matters
rows with the same 2-5 attributes (phase, where, when, budget)
never when: never as a title, never for two long columns of prose (use panels)
fields: rail(<=28 chars, the table's title goes here, may be empty), heading(head of column 1), sub(head of column 2), lead(head of column 3): each a column name the rows fill, <=20 chars, never empty and never a title (e.g. "Phase", "Where and when", "Budget"); items(1-8 rows: label(column 1), body(column 2), extra(column 3), each <=60 chars)

signals in the source: named people with a role and an email
never when: never without names the brief gives; never anywhere but last
fields: rail("Contact"), lead(one bold sentence before the names, e.g. what kind of partners are sought, may be empty), items(1-4: label(name), body(role, team), extra(email address))
